chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Hubaysh al-Katib reported to me, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Za'farani, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, from al-Mas'udi, from Yahya ibn Salim al-'Abdi, from Maysara, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Zarr ibn Hubaysh who said:

Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, passed by riding the mule of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, while Salman was among a gathering. So Salman, may Allah's mercy be upon him, said: "Will you not rise and take hold of his waistband and ask him? By Allah, Who split the grain and created the living creature, no one other than him will inform you about the secrets of your Prophet. Indeed, he is the most learned of the earth and its pillar, and to him it finds its rest. If you were to lose him, you would lose knowledge, and you would not recognize the people."

key_terms.بغلة رسول الله: The mule of the Messenger of Allah - riding the Prophet's mount signified special status
key_terms.سر نبيكم: The secrets of your Prophet - hidden knowledge entrusted exclusively to Ali
key_terms.عالم الأرض: The most learned of the earth

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farsi say about Imam Ali's knowledge and status?
ai.summary: Salman al-Farsi, a revered companion of the Prophet, urged the people to seek knowledge from Imam Ali (AS) as he passed by riding the Prophet's own mule. Speaking to a public gathering in the early Islamic period, Salman swore a solemn oath that Ali alone held the secrets of the Prophet and was the most learned person on earth.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 2. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Hubaish al-Katib reported to me from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali al-Zafarani, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from al-Masoodi, who reported from Yahya ibn Salim al-Abdi, who reported from Maysarah, from al-Minhal ibn Amru, from Zarr ibn Hubaish who said:

Once, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, passed by riding the Prophet’s mule and Salman was present among the people. So Salman - may Allah bless him with mercy, said: "(O people)! do you not rise to detain him and ask him questions? By Allah, Who split the grain and created the breathing creatures, no one but he (i.e. ‘Ali) will inform you about the secrets of your Prophet. Indeed, he is the most learned about this earth and its chief element on which it rests. If you miss him, you will miss the knowledge and deny the people (its benefit)."
